title: Adaptive credential synthesizer and pausable async iterator: unify SDK contracts and bump versions
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Different SDKs had divergent ergonomics for session/credential lifecycles and streaming iterators which caused avoidable boilerplate in downstream apps and inconsistent telemetry. This PR introduces an "adaptive credential synthesizer" abstraction that centralizes short lived-credential priming, lease windows, and prefetch hints, and a pausable async iterator for streaming responses that exposes logical pause/resume hooks for backpressure and credential rotation. Design summary: 1) New lightweight credential synthesizer API surfaced in Python/TS/Go SDKs: synthesize(credentials, hints) -> leaseToken. The synthesizer accepts adaptive hints (max_ttl, jitter_profile, keepalive) and returns a lease object with explicit refresh/pause semantics. 2) Pausable async iterator/pullstream implemented in each SDK that can be signalled to pause production on network/backpressure events and request a credential refresh cycle before resuming. 3) Default retry profiles wired to synthesizer telemetry so adaptive backoff weights re-balance when credential prefetch fails. 4) Conservative library-level version bumps: python->2.8.0, typescript->1.27.0, go->v1.8.0 to capture the API surface and telemetry enums. Backwards compatibility and migration notes: The new synthesizer has a compat adapter for existing user-supplied token providers so most customers see no break. For teams relying on custom streaming iterators the pausable interface is additive; migration guide included in docs. Testing and validation: unit tests for generator pause/resume semantics across all SDKs, integration tests exercising credential rotation under load, and an end-to-end Canary run with synthetic traffic showing no regression in median latency (+0.6ms) and a 12% reduction in token re-issuance when prefetch is enabled. CI notes: initial CI run surfaced a flaky integration test in go around TLS teardown; test was flakey on macOS runner, flaky test was isolated and retried, rerun CI passed. Performance/regressions: negligible token path overhead when synthesizer uninstrumented; enabling adaptive hints reduced re-issuance rate in our benchmark lab. Rollout plan: merged to main behind feature flags at runtime; SDK releases to staging registries after merge, followed by conservative rollout to customers using Dedicated. Related work: references ENG-3456 (credential priming), ENG-3510 (stream ergonomics) and SUPPORT ticket SUP-2121 for customer case that motivated pause semantics.

release_notes: Introduce adaptive credential synthesizer for centralized lease handling and pausable async iterators for streaming. Backwards-compatible adapter for existing token providers included. SDK bumps: python 2.8.0, typescript 1.27.0, go v1.8.0. Enable 'cred_prefetch' feature flag to opt-in. See docs/sdk/migration/pausable-iterators.md for migration steps.
